# Offline dependencies

Required source from Dear ImGui v1.92.9 and MinHook v1.3.4 is retained here so Build.cmd does not need to download dependencies. ImGui includes its core headers/sources and the DX11 backend; MinHook includes its library sources and CMake support. These are upstream dependencies, not alternate project sources or old release copies. License texts are included in each source tree and in the project's licenses folder.
